title: ISA Atmosphere Model
text: Implement International Standard Atmosphere (ISA), 1 input, 6 outputs, {Action for out-of-range input} sets Out-of-range block behavior; {Use extended ISA model} sets the range of implementation, {S}, {T ref} sets the reference temperature, {μ ref} sets the reference dynamic viscosity, {Output kinematic and dynamic viscosity} sets the option to output kinematic and dynamic, {Change atmospheric parameters} sets the customize parameters, {Acceleration due to gravity (m/s^2)}, {Ratio of specific heats} sets the ratio of heats, {Characteristic gas constant (J/Kg/K)} sets the gas constant, {Lapse rate (K/m)}, {Height of troposphere (m)} sets the troposphere height, {Height of tropopause (m)} sets the tropopause height, {Air density at mean sea level (Kg/m^3)}, {Ambient pressure at mean sea level (N/m^2)}, {Ambient temperature at mean sea level (K)} and {Lowest altitude (m)}. Values come from the instance.
